name: fft3d_r2c_halfspec_f32
description: Batch-of-1 3D real-to-complex FFT over a C-contiguous [nz, ny, nx] float32 grid (x fastest-varying). Output is the packed Hermitian half-spectrum as interleaved float32 [nz, ny, nx//2+1, 2] with x-row stride exactly nx//2+1 (no even-row padding), unnormalized. Targets scientific spectral-solver grids: 24..256 per axis, anisotropic (non-cubic) shapes allowed.
reference:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
import torch


def run(input):
    """3D real-to-complex FFT, unnormalized, packed Hermitian half-spectrum output.

    input:  float32 [nz, ny, nx], x fastest-varying (C-contiguous).
    return: float32 [nz, ny, nx//2+1, 2] interleaved (re, im), row stride
            exactly nx//2+1 with no even-row padding, unnormalized
            (i.e., inverse of the result sums to N * input).
    """
    x = input.to(torch.float64)
    out = torch.fft.rfftn(x, norm="backward")            # half spectrum on last dim
    return torch.view_as_real(out).to(torch.float32)
